english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for intense physical or emotional suffering.
This is the all-purpose noun for severe physical or emotional suffering.
This is the all-purpose noun for extreme physical or emotional pain and distress.
This is the all-purpose noun for suffering or emotional pain, including grief.
This is the all-purpose choice for a state of physical or emotional pain and distress.
Use this when focusing on the intense suffering experienced rather than the act or treatment causing it.
Use this for emotional suffering or distress when the sorrow is experienced as painful.
Use this when the physical or mental distress is substantial and amounts to suffering rather than mild discomfort.
Use this for mental or emotional suffering rather than a merely physical ache.
Use this when the emphasis is on intense emotional pain or anguish rather than anxiety.

examples.english: Being this sick lately has put me in misery.
examples.traditional: 呢排病到咁，我真係好痛苦。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 beng6 dou3 gam3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2

examples.english: I'm in such agony that I can't sleep.

examples.english: Seeing my mother suffer causes me anguish.
examples.traditional: 見到媽媽病得咁辛苦，我個心真係好痛苦。
examples.jyutping: gin3 dou2 maa1 maa1 beng6 dak1 gam3 san1 fu2 ngo5 go3 sam1 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2

examples.english: That period of unemployment caused me a lot of grief.
